'''Piotr Józef Myśliwiec''' (born 21 August 1952 in [[Proszowice]])<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.luanda.msz.gov.pl/pt/embaixada/embaixador/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180212165645/http://www.luanda.msz.gov.pl/pt/embaixada/embaixador/|url-status=dead|archive-date=2018-02-12|title=Embaixador|date=2018-02-12|website=luanda.msz.gov.pl|language=pt|access-date=2019-05-28}}</ref> is a Polish diplomat and chemist, serving as a Poland ambassador to [[Angola]] (2007–2010, 2015–2023).

== Life ==

Piotr Myśliwiec was born on 21 August 1952 in [[Proszowice]]. He was educated at [[Tadeusz Kościuszko University of Technology]], Faculty of Chemistry. In 1990, he defended his Ph.D. thesis on [[adsorption]] of [[water vapor]] at the [[Wrocław University of Science and Technology]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=30758&_k=7qzmzz|title=Nowa Nauka Polska|website=nauka-polska.pl|language=pl|access-date=2019-05-28}}</ref>

In the early 1990s, Myśliwiec joined the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Poland)|Polish diplomatic service]]. From 1993 to 2001, he held post of [[chargé d'Affaires a.i.]] at the Polish embassy in [[Abidjan]], [[Ivory Coast]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://orka.sejm.gov.pl/Biuletyn.nsf/wgskrnr5/SZA-85|title=Zapis przebiegu posiedzenia Komisji Spraw Zagranicznych /nr 85/|date=2007-06-28|website=orka.sejm.gov.pl|language=pl|access-date=2019-05-28|archive-date=2023-07-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230716064818/http://orka.sejm.gov.pl/Biuletyn.nsf/wgskrnr5/SZA-85|url-status=dead}}</ref> Later, he was in positions of Poland ambassador to Angola from 2007 to 1 September 2010.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://prawo.sejm.gov.pl/isap.nsf/DocDetails.xsp?id=WMP20100700885|title=Postanowienie Prezydenta Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej z dnia 1 września 2010 r. nr 110-43-2010 w sprawie odwołania Ambasadora Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej|date=2010-09-01|website=prawo.sejm.gov.pl|language=pl|access-date=2019-05-28}}</ref> He returned on that post in July 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://msz.gov.pl/pl/aktualnosci/wiadomosci/nominacje_ambasadorow_w_rumunii__i_angoli;jsessionid=5D1809BD05497B8C8ED8A207945CE42C.cmsap5p|title=Nominacje dla nowych ambasadorów RP w Rumunii i Angoli|date=2015-07-09|website=msz.gov.pl|language=pl|access-date=2019-05-28}}</ref> He was also accredited to the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], the [[Republic of the Congo]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://prawo.sejm.gov.pl/isap.nsf/DocDetails.xsp?id=WMP20160000159|title=Postanowienie Prezydenta Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej z dnia 22 stycznia 2016 r. nr 110.1.2016 w sprawie mianowania Ambasadora Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej|date=2016-01-22|website=prawo.sejm.gov.pl|language=pl|access-date=2019-05-28}}</ref> [[Gabon]], [[Central African Republic]] and [[São Tomé and Príncipe]].<ref name=":0" /> He ended his term on 31 October 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Monitor Polski 2023 r. poz. 1162 |url=https://monitorpolski.gov.pl/MP/2023/1162/M2023000116201.pdf |access-date=2023-10-30 |website=monitorpolski.gov.pl}}</ref>

Apart from his native [[Polish language|Polish]], he speaks [[Portuguese language|Portuguese]], [[French language|French]] and [[English language|English]]. He has also basic knowledge of [[Swahili language|swahili]] and [[lingala]] languages.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sejm.gov.pl/sejm7.nsf/biuletyn.xsp?documentId=F0442488666A7341C1257E770048A940|title=Zapis przebiegu posiedzenia Komisji Spraw Zagranicznych /nr 183/|date=2015-06-23|website=www.sejm.gov.pl|language=pl|access-date=2019-05-28}}</ref>
